```
private boolean hasFeature(Element root, String feature) {
    NodeList features = root.getElementsByTagName(TAG_USES_FEATURE);
    for (int i=0; i<features.getLength(); i++) {
        Element f = (Element) features.item(i);
        String fname = f.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_URI, ATTR_NAME);
        if (feature.equals(fname)) {
            String required = f.getAttributeNS(ANDROID_URI, ATTR_REQUIRED);
            return "false".equals(required);
        }
    }
    return false;
}
```
